result.title: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude. Types suit reinforcement learning: a type constrains what an agent may choose, not how it chooses, so the guarantee holds for every policy a learner produces. We introduce epistemic typestates, a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning. An agent's type is a protocol whose states record its beliefs, the worlds it cannot rule out from its own observations and actions, and permits only actions that are safe in every world of the belief, whatever the others do within their public types. Agents learn inside their types, which are built and checked one agent at a time and run without communication. We prove type soundness and team safety, give a synthesis that is sound and complete, build types from guards when worlds are infinite, and show that shields are a special case. All proofs are mechanised in Rocq. On nine benchmarks, no typed learner causes a safety violation, and task performance does not differ significantly from that of two recent multi-agent shielding methods. Where a contract-based method fails at five and ten agents, types for ten agents are built in under a second. In the two continuous benchmarks, Lagrangian learners cause thousands of violations in every training run.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「认知类型态」（epistemic typestates）：为多智能体强化学习中的每个智能体构造一个类型协议，状态刻画其信念（从自身观测与动作无法排除的世界），并只允许在所有可能世界上都安全的动作；智能体在类型内学习，类型逐个构造与检查、运行期无需通信，文中给出类型可靠性与团队安全性证明、完备的综合算法，并将 shielding 视作特例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信念=不可排除世界集合」的状态抽象与逐智能体独立合成、可作为约束嵌入学习过程的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何保留任务必要信息、以及推理期何时必须获取更多证据提供可核查的形式化参照，但无视觉或多模态推理实验支持。
